\title{Attention-Based Sequence Transduction with Residual Scaling}
\author{Alice Nguyen\thanks{University of Example, alice@example.edu} \and Bob Smith\thanks{Example Labs, bob@example.com}}
\begin{document}\maketitle
\begin{abstract}We propose a simple network architecture based solely on attention mechanisms. Experiments on two translation tasks show that our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on English-to-German, improving over the best existing results by 2.0 BLEU, while requiring significantly less time to train.\end{abstract}
\section{Introduction}Recurrent networks \cite{hochreiter1997} have been the dominant approach. In this work we show that attention alone suffices.
